# Featherlane AI UI

> @danielbaker06072001/featherlane-ai-ui@9.5.0, a Tro-branded fork of Material UI 9.5.0.

- [Complete assistant guide](./llms-full.txt): setup, semantic tokens, actual exports, examples, provenance and limits.
- [Package README](./README.md): installation modes and peer dependencies.
- [License](./LICENSE): retained core MIT terms.

Use createTroTheme({design}) from @danielbaker06072001/featherlane-ai-ui/styles and one project setup file. Use deep component imports. The source workspace retains @mui/material names; the release artifact is separately named. A registry release is not implied by these files. The compatibility alias @mui/material@npm:@danielbaker06072001/featherlane-ai-ui@9.5.0 supports existing MUI imports and icon peers after publication.
